# awreport

> File a bug report that has already scrubbed your secrets and collapsed the duplicate.

A bug report is the artifact most likely to carry a credential -- logs, a config dump, an env var someone exported to reproduce the fault -- and the person writing it is already frustrated and will not read it twice. So the secret ships, or the report never gets filed at all.

## Install

```
pip install awreport
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Turn a failure into a filed, redacted GitHub issue that collapses into the duplicate when one exists.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awreport

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awreport.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
